# KongGoo (摃菇)

> KongGoo is a desktop GPS location simulator for USB-connected iPhones, built for location-based games, location testing, and more.

## Overview

KongGoo runs on macOS (Intel and Apple Silicon) and Windows 10+. It simulates or changes the GPS location of a USB-connected iPhone running iOS 16 or later. iPhone Developer Mode is required; no jailbreak is needed. Use it with location-based games such as Pikmin Bloom and Pokemon GO, or for location testing.

## Features

- Teleport to any location and plan routes. Scatter route mode runs for up to 5 minutes per run, then stops automatically.
- Search by landmark, address, or latitude and longitude; save favorite places grouped by country.
- Cross-platform for macOS and Windows. The macOS build is Apple notarized.

## Pricing

- Free 7-day trial, no credit card, and no automatic charge after the trial.
- Taiwan (Traditional Chinese, https://konggoo.uk/): NT$690/year and NT$1,750 lifetime, priced in TWD.
- International pages (/en/, /ja/, /ko/, /zh-CN/): US$22 annual license (one-time payment for 1 year, no auto-renewal) and US$55 lifetime license.
- Japan reference prices: approximately ¥3,300/year and ¥8,300 lifetime. Korea reference prices: approximately ₩30,000/year and ₩76,000 lifetime.
- One license key binds to one device.

## FAQ

- **Will the trial charge me automatically?** No. There is no automatic charge after the free 7-day trial.
- **Developer Mode is missing on my iPhone.** Developer Mode requires iOS 16 or later. Connect the iPhone by USB and tap “Initialize connection” in KongGoo first; then check Settings > Privacy & Security.
- **How long can a route run?** Each scatter route run lasts up to 5 minutes, then stops automatically.
- **Can I use one license on multiple devices?** No. One license key binds to one device.
- **Why does macOS ask for an administrator password during initialization?** USB communication with iOS devices needs administrator rights.
- **Will macOS show a “damaged” warning?** Normally it is not shown because the app is Apple notarized.
